newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Grenade found in Belgian central bank kitchen.
newsitem.headline: Grenade found in Belgian central bank kitchen.

text.p: A World War One grenade found among potatoes delivered to the staff canteen set off a major security alert at Belgium's central bank on Thursday.
Police sealed off streets around the bank while an army bomb disposal unit was called to defuse the grenade but the bank itself was not evacuated, a police spokeswoman said.

"The army specialists decided the grenade was too old and dangerous to be transported back to their headquarters so they decided to blow it up in the nearest park, which was the Royal Park," she told Reuters.
Old grenades often turn up in Belgium. Last year army units spent several days clearing thousands of German-made explosives from a river in the south of the country.
"It's difficult to say where it came from. The whole of Belgium has been a battlefield at one time or another," the police spokeswoman said.
